admissible_source_evidence.variant_a:
Check-in notes

Thirty days after you write a check-in note, it is deleted. A note can be deleted sooner by you, from its menu. Once deleted, a note cannot be brought back. At no point does the group steward see your check-in notes.
admissible_source_evidence.variant_b:
Check-in notes

Your check-in notes are deleted thirty days after you write them. You can delete a note sooner from its menu. A deleted note cannot be brought back. The group steward does not see your check-in notes at any point.
